req.title: Reject invalid date-of-birth format
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when dateOfBirth cannot be parsed as ISO-8601 date.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-024 requires HTTP 422 when dateOfBirth cannot be parsed as ISO-8601. Analysis of the source reveals that PlayerRequestModel.date_of_birth is typed as Optional[str], meaning Pydantic itself will NOT reject arbitrary strings at the model level — the validation must be enforced elsewhere (e.g. a validator or the route layer). The test suite must: (1) confirm a valid ISO-8601 date is accepted (positive/EP), (2) confirm clearly malformed strings are rejected with 422 (negative/EP, NEG), (3) probe boundary values such as the empty string, a date-only string vs datetime string, and strings that are almost-valid ISO-8601 (BVA). Because date_of_birth is Optional[str] in the model, the system's actual rejection behaviour depends on any custom validator present; tests are written to assert the requirement's stated contract (422 on unparseable input). Squad numbers used for POST are chosen outside the pre-loaded range (27+) to avoid 409 conflicts.

tests.name: test_post_player_valid_iso8601_date_accepted
preconditions: FastAPI app is running in-process via TestClient
Squad number 27 does not exist in the database
actions: POST /players/ with a well-formed ISO-8601 date string '1990-06-15' in dateOfBirth
expected: Response body contains the submitted dateOfBirth value
trace: R-PLAYER-024: valid ISO-8601 date must not trigger 422
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_post_player_valid_iso8601_date_accepted():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "dateOfBirth": "1990-06-15",
        "squadNumber": 27,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["dateOfBirth"] == "1990-06-15"

test_post_player_valid_iso8601_date_accepted()

actions: POST /players/ with a valid ISO-8601 datetime string of exactly 24 characters

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

        "firstName": "Boundary",
        "lastName": "Dob",
        "dateOfBirth": dob_24,

    }

    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["dateOfBirth"] == dob_24
